outcome: abnormal iron and folic acid deficiency anemia
cohort: The study included all consecutive cases of twin pregnancies admitted to the Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology, RIMS (Regional Institute of Medical Sciences), Imphal.
finding: Mothers with parity 1 and 2 or more were 79% and 94% less likely to give birth to both twins with low birthweight compared to primiparous mothers, respectively, with booking status, literacy, parity, type of placenta, presentation, preterm labor, and polyhydramnios identified as significant risk factors for preterm birth and low birth weight.
cross-section timing: During admission for twin pregnancy, covering outcomes at or around birth.
gest_age: preterm birth (specific gestational age not mentioned)
